name: setSubsetString
description: Sets the subset string used to filter features. Returns True if successful. The subset string is typically an OGR WHERE clause.

name: selectedFeatures
description: Returns a list of all selected features. Use selectByIds() or the selection tool to select features.

name: selectByIds
description: Selects features by their feature IDs. Mode can be SetSelection, AddToSelection, RemoveFromSelection, or IntersectingSelection.

name: removeSelection
description: Clears the current selection, removing all selected features from the selection set.

name: startEditing
description: Puts the layer in edit mode, enabling feature creation, modification, and deletion. Returns True if successful.

name: commitChanges
description: Saves changes made to the layer. If stopEditing is True, exits edit mode. Returns True if successful.

name: rollback
description: Discards all uncommitted changes and exits edit mode. Returns True if rollback was successful.

name: addFeature
description: Adds a new feature to the layer. The feature must have valid geometry compatible with the layer's geometry type.

name: deleteFeature
description: Deletes a feature from the layer by its feature ID. The layer must be in edit mode.

name: updateFeature
description: Updates a feature's geometry and attributes. Must be called after modifying a feature in edit mode.

name: dataProvider
description: Returns the layer's data provider, which handles data access and manipulation at a low level.

name: fields
description: Returns the layer's field definitions (QgFields), containing all attribute column names and types.

name: geometryType
description: Returns the geometry type of the layer: Point, LineString, Polygon, or UnknownGeometry.

name: crs
description: Returns the coordinate reference system (CRS) associated with the layer.

name: extent
description: Returns the spatial extent (bounding box) of all features in the layer.

name: featureCount
description: Returns the total number of features in the layer (including any subset filter).

name: setCrs
signature: setCrs(crs: QgCoordinateReferenceSystem, emitSignal: bool = True) -> None
description: Sets the layer's coordinate reference system. If emitSignal is True, emits crsChanged signal.

name: getFeature
description: Returns the feature with the given feature ID, or an invalid feature if not found.

name: getFeatures
description: Returns an iterator over features, optionally filtered by a QgFeatureRequest with expressions, spatial filters, or subset strings.

name: clone
description: Creates a deep copy of the layer with the same source, style, and settings.

name: setName
description: Sets the display name of the layer shown in the Layers panel and other UI elements.

name: styleManager
description: Returns the style manager for managing multiple styles (symbology) associated with the layer.
